name: Different shell view - AI apps
author: miguel
description: Like the ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity desktop apps: your chats in a sidebar on the left that folds to a slim rail, the chat in a centred column, your apps in one column on the right (pinned, then open, then +), an app opening as a panel beside the chat. Desktop only: the phone keeps the standard phone view. Works with every skin. One view per device type (desktop, phone); all off = Desks
